desc: Sort all arrays in descending order and initialize the heap with \((0,0,0)\).
Implement the score \(A_iB_j+B_jC_k+C_kA_i\) using negative scores in Python’s min-heap.
Track visited index triples and expand valid forward neighbors.
Pop exactly \(K\) states and output the K-th popped score.
Validate all supplied samples; confirm \(O(K\log K)\) time and \(O(K)\) memory.
